notes.text: Completed audit at main 27df0e3109d5eff56a2d102ed0181ba9e585d8f5. See NOTE-20260907-dashboard-refresh-audit for detailed plan and executable evidence. Four events / three clients / two repositories / three worktrees produced 96 real Git commands and 64,620 service JSON bytes. Delayed readers reached 18 concurrent repository reads. Failing storage generated ten scans in one second of virtual time with no external logs. The browser reproduced an older response overwriting a newer one. Two server probes and one browser probe passed as bug reproductions; no production implementation, restart or deployment. Item remains open and now-priority.

problem: Every changed SSE event triggers a full dashboard fetch. Each dashboard snapshot runs Git worktree discovery and git status for every worktree. Continuous log output can emit changes roughly every 250 ms per connected dashboard, with overlapping requests and no shared Git cache.

Failed storage measurements publish changed, and the next full dashboard read immediately schedules another attempt because freshness uses only the last successful measurement. This produces a self-sustaining refresh loop without new log output.

The dashboard blindly applies overlapping HTTP responses, allowing older data to overwrite newer state; it also ignores SSE ready on reconnect. MCP project listings use the full dashboard query and incur the same hidden discovery work.

risk.rollback: Revert the focused implementation change without changing existing project configuration or unrelated runtime ownership.

scope: Separate log/runtime/test-output updates from Git discovery and configuration changes. Serve cached worktree metadata with freshness/error information and an explicit refresh path.
Coalesce concurrent discovery for the same repository, bound Git subprocess concurrency, and invalidate or refresh on relevant operations. Do not add recursive watchers.
Prevent overlapping dashboard refreshes from applying stale responses. Preserve fast log updates and authorize all incremental endpoints through existing boundaries.

Read notes/NOTE-20260907-dashboard-refresh-audit/audit-and-plan.md before implementation. Follow its staged read-projection, bounded Git admission, event/live-query and browser reconciliation plan; proposed limits and APIs are not existing contracts.

Keep metadata caching exclusive to display/read projections. Preserve fresh Git discovery, validation and existing shared lifecycle coordination for runtime operations, reserve/claim, test admission and storage/cache mutations.
Make live storage reads side-effect-free and add failed-attempt cooldown separate from successful measurement freshness. Preserve the existing serialized scanner and busy checks.
Remove full dashboard discovery from existing MCP project listing/resources without changing their public response contracts; defer broader compact MCP APIs to FEAT-20260905-compact-mcp-status.

Bound and dispose metadata cache entries, Git command admission and pending event scopes. Reconcile reconnects and merge response sections using controller epoch/revisions; preserve i18n, authorization and resource-sample ordering.
source: Repository assessment and owner direction on 2026-09-05
title: Stop log updates from repeatedly scanning every worktree
validation: Warm cache: four output-only events, three clients, two repositories and three worktrees per repository cause zero additional Git commands, preset discoveries or storage scheduling, including after TTL expiry. Cold concurrent bootstrap readers share two worktree-list and six status commands; actual Git subprocess concurrency stays within its cap.

Cover explicit refresh, TTL/cooldown, invalidation during a refresh, partial Git errors, admission/cache saturation and shutdown. Removed worktrees must still be rejected by fresh operational validation; failures retain last good display data with explicit staleness/unknown status.

Failed storage fixture schedules only its two initial attempts during one second, with zero notification-triggered retries. Later eligible/manual retry obeys cooldown policy, serialized scanning and lifecycle/busy checks.

Browser tests prove request coalescing, latest state preservation, reconnect reconciliation without another event, locale/unmount cancellation, project removal and metrics ordering. Verify English/Polish freshness and refresh UI and endpoint authorization/input validation.
Existing MCP project summaries perform zero Git, preset or storage scheduling work. Runtime output avoids test-history reads. Existing detailed read contracts remain compatible.

Repeat the attached real Git fixture with identical before/after sizes and separate cold/warm phases; record Git calls, response bytes, latency, Node CPU/RSS and separately measured child CPU if available. The audit baseline observed 0/32/96 Git commands for 0/1/3 clients; this is not an after-fix result or production benchmark.

Run relevant unit/integration tests, pnpm check, pnpm build and affected browser flows using registered-project queue presets when available and serial heavy verification. Audit attachments are positive bug reproductions, not permanent passing regression tests for the fixed behavior.
value: The dashboard stays cheap during the noisy builds and agent sessions it is meant to coordinate.
